comments.body:
RCA (Phase 1 complete — rebar-debug). CONFIRMED root cause, single mechanism.

Mechanism: The provider-parity tests drive the REAL production Bedrock path
(build_bedrock_provider @ src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py:152), which constructs
`boto3.session.Session(region_name=region)`. boto3 Session construction eagerly
resolves the ambient AWS profile via botocore, honoring $AWS_PROFILE and reading it
from the operator's real ~/.aws/config (default AWS_CONFIG_FILE). The test helper
`_capture` (tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py:634-637) injects dummy
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET and a region, but does NOT isolate the profile/config-FILE
resolution. So on a dev box with AWS_PROFILE=frontier + a matching [profile frontier]
in ~/.aws/config the Session builds and `.converse` is captured (29 pass); under an
empty/arbitrary HOME the named profile is absent and Session construction raises
botocore.exceptions.ProfileNotFound BEFORE `converse`, so no payload is captured and
the 6 listed tests fail with "no outbound request captured for 'bedrock:...'".

Discriminating proof (runtime):
- real HOME: 29 passed. empty HOME: 6 failed / 23 passed (reproduced).
- Surfaced exception under empty HOME: ProfileNotFound: config profile (frontier)
  from boto3.session.Session.__init__ -> botocore get_scoped_config.
- Redirect AWS_CONFIG_FILE/AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE to injected empty files AND
  DELETE AWS_PROFILE/AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE under empty HOME -> 29 passed. This isolates
  ONLY the AWS profile/config-file read (not $HOME, not ~/.gitconfig identity), the
  DIFFERENT seam this ticket calls for vs frousy's MCP-scanner default-home seam.
- Negative control: setting AWS_PROFILE="" (present-but-empty) still fails (profile
  named "") — proving the read is specifically profile-NAME resolution against the
  config-file location, ruling out env-credential/region as the cause.

Legitimacy: defect (test-hermeticity). Authoritative contract: the unit tier's
"never touch the real environment" invariant, embodied in the existing autouse
conftest fixtures `_no_real_session_log_writes` and `_isolated_mcp_client_home`, plus
this ticket's acceptance criteria. Production provider behavior is CORRECT (reading
AWS_PROFILE is how AWS auth works) and is NOT changed — the fix is test-only.

Defect origin (caused_by): 0d76-ebbf-ee3a-48ac (musical-followable-mouflon, "S6 —
clear the parity bar for Bedrock"), via introducing commit 07d19c5537e1 ("0d76: prove
payload and tool parity"), which added `_capture` and asserted the suite "stays
offline and credential-free" while omitting AWS profile/config isolation. The
non-hermeticity has existed since introduction (git blame: 2026-08-02) with no
good->bad transition, so 0d76 is the origin, not a carrier or an unmet obligation.
Class: plan_defect.

Fix (Phase 2): a tier-wide autouse conftest fixture in tests/unit/conftest.py that
redirects AWS_CONFIG_FILE/AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE to an injected empty per-session
dir and neutralizes AWS_PROFILE/AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE — mirroring _isolated_mcp_client_home,
isolating only the credential/config read, leaving $HOME and git identity untouched.

compiled_state.description:
## Problem

Several unit tests in the LLM/provider suite silently depend on the operator's REAL HOME (specifically `~/.aws` credentials/config) to construct boto/anthropic clients far enough to capture outbound payloads. They pass on a developer box with ambient AWS config but FAIL on a hermetic empty HOME.

## Evidence (runtime-confirmed, worktree debug/frousy-whale)

```
# real HOME
python -m pytest tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py -q   -> 29 passed
# isolated empty HOME (HOME=<empty dir>)
HOME=<empty> python -m pytest tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py -q  -> 6 failed, 23 passed
```

Failing under empty HOME:
- test_the_outbound_payload_is_equivalent_across_providers[frontier|standard]
- test_the_tool_set_offered_to_the_model_is_identical_across_providers[frontier|standard]
- test_the_temperature_capability_difference_is_symmetric_and_explicit
- test_the_native_output_capability_is_measured_and_symmetric_for_sonnet

Related modules with the same latent dependency observed during ec07-692f-af32-4818 whole-tier $HOME-isolation experiment: test_llm_capabilities, test_web_tool_gating, test_cache_prefix_breakpoint.

## Why separate from frousy-ornamental-whale

frousy-ornamental-whale fixed the DOCTOR MCP-client scan non-hermeticity with a surgical seam patch (redirect scan_mcp_clients default home). That change deliberately does NOT touch $HOME, precisely because these AWS/LLM tests rely on the real home — so whole-tier $HOME isolation has too broad a blast radius. Making these tests hermetic needs a DIFFERENT seam (inject AWS credentials/region/config into the provider-client construction, or stub the boto/anthropic client factory) and is a design decision, not a drop-in.

## Acceptance criteria
1. The listed provider/LLM unit tests pass deterministically under an empty/arbitrary HOME with no ambient ~/.aws.
2. The fix injects or stubs the AWS/provider client construction seam (no reliance on operator home state); it does not weaken the payload/tool-set assertions.
3. No change to production provider behavior.
compiled_state.title: LLM/AWS provider unit tests are non-hermetic: they read the operator's real ~/.aws HOME to build clients
